toConfirm: productName must equal the name reserved for 9NDMQVXLGBQJ, and publisherDisplayName the account's publisher; both are assumed (Meshcraft's listing uses publisher K3D0).

preparedFields.privacyPolicy: To be published; Wirecraft has no privacy policy page yet (Meshcraft's is docs/PRIVACY_POLICY.md in its repository).
preparedFields.accessesPersonalInformation: Yes — user-selected project files may contain personal information (responsible, assignee and revision fields); optional local MCP clients can read the design. No automatic developer analytics or project upload.
preparedFields.certificationNotes: Desktop dataflow designer and code generator. No login, subscription or external server is needed; the app starts its own backend bound to 127.0.0.1. Test with keyboard and mouse: open an example .orch from the portable release (examples/webserver-rust.orch), use the Designer tab, select an entity and open the Editor tab. Code checks, completion and hover need clang/clangd or rust-analyzer installed separately; without them the editor still works with syntax colors. The optional MCP server binds only to 127.0.0.1 with a bearer token; external agent clients are separate. The interface is English; Store descriptions and captions are localized. Needs graphics drivers supporting DirectX 11.

accountOnlyStepsNotRepresentableInListin.ageRating: Complete the Partner Center/IARC questionnaire. No official rating has been assigned by this bundle. The app is a user-operated software design tool; the examples are web-server designs.
accountOnlyStepsNotRepresentableInListin.marketsAndPublicationDate: Use the publisher's chosen markets and schedule; no account settings were changed.
accountOnlyStepsNotRepresentableInListin.publisherContactAndTraderDeclarations: Use the verified publisher details already held in Partner Center. No address, phone number or private email is included here.
accountOnlyStepsNotRepresentableInListin.packageUpload: Upload signed MSIX packages built with the reserved Store identity (Package/Identity/Name and Publisher from Partner Center > Product identity). The release workflow currently signs a self-signed CN=Wirecraft identity, which the Store will not accept until packaging/windows/msix-identity.json carries the reserved values.
accountOnlyStepsNotRepresentableInListin.finalSubmission: Import and review the listing, complete account-only declarations, then submit in Partner Center. The local build does not publish or certify the app.
